title: Autopilot Figma Mutation Proposal
description: A proposed Figma write. Workers may ONLY produce proposals; the plugin executor applies an approved proposal behind the control-plane approval queue. Ops are a closed, typed allowlist — there is no arbitrary-code op. See docs/decisions/figma-write-plugin-executor-adr.md.

briefHash.description: sha256 of the Design Brief this mutation derives from.

expectedVersion.description: Figma document version the proposal was built against; the executor aborts on a mismatch.

ops.description: Typed operations from the closed allowlist. No arbitrary-code op exists.

target.description: Node id the op acts on (for ops that modify an existing node).

args.description: Op-specific parameters. Token layers reference token names, never raw values.

versionCheckpoint.description: The executor must save a named Figma version-history checkpoint before applying — always required.
